name: Field instrumentation
description: Field instrumentation for the 7-unit gas-engine generator plant and SESB 132/33/11 kV connection. Procurement / I&C. BOQ quantities and dimensions are design inputs, not sourced facts.

specifications.metric: Emerson Rosemount 3051 pressure transm — reference accuracy
specifications.basis: Emerson Rosemount 3051 Product Data Sheet 00813-0100-4001 Rev TA, February 2017 (PDF hosted by instrumart.com, read via r.jina.ai): 'Reference accuracy 0.04 percent of span'.

specifications.metric: Emerson Rosemount 3051 pressure transm — installed total performance
specifications.basis: Rosemount 3051 PDS, February 2017, read via r.jina.ai: 'Installed total performance of 0.14 percent of span'.
Rosemount 3051 PDS, February 2017, read via r.jina.ai: '10-year stability of 0.2 percent of URL'.

specifications.metric: Emerson Rosemount 3051 pressure transm — safety certification
specifications.basis: Rosemount 3051 PDS, February 2017, read via r.jina.ai: 'SIL2/3 certified (IEC 61508)' and ordering option 'QT Safety certified to IEC 61508 with certificate of FMEDA'. (value: SIL2/3 certified to IEC 61508 (option QT safety certified with FMEDA certificate)

specifications.metric: Emerson Rosemount 3051 pressure transm — installed base
specifications.unit: million units (stated as 'Over seven million installed', February 2017 edition)
specifications.basis: Rosemount 3051 PDS, February 2017, read via r.jina.ai: 'Over seven million installed'. A later Emerson PDF preview (October 2025) states 'More than ten million installed' but that edition was not readable in this session.

specifications.metric: Emerson Rosemount 3051 pressure transm — output protocols
specifications.basis: Rosemount 3051 PDS, February 2017, read via r.jina.ai: transmitter output table 'A 4–20 mA with Digital Signal Based on HART Protocol; F FOUNDATION Fieldbus Protocol; W PROFIBUS PA Protocol; X Wireless ... WA3 ... 2.4GHz Wireless HART; M Low-Power, 1–5 Vdc with Digital Signal Based on HART Protocol'. (value: 4-20 mA HART, FOUNDATION Fieldbus, PROFIBUS PA, WirelessHART (2.4 GHz), low-powe)

specifications.metric: Emerson Rosemount 3051 pressure transm — pressure range example (3051TG range 5)
specifications.basis: Rosemount 3051 PDS, February 2017, read via r.jina.ai: Rosemount 3051TG gage pressure range 5 '-14.7 to 10000 psi (-1,01 to 689,47 bar)'.

specifications.metric: Yokogawa Plant Resource Manager (PRM)  — supported field protocols
specifications.basis: Yokogawa CENTUM VP General Specifications GS 33K01A10-50E, 12th Edition Sep. 1, 2014, read via r.jina.ai: 'PRM communicates with devices with digital communication functions such as Foundation fieldbus, HART, and field wireless (complies with ISA 100.11a) devices'. (value: FOUNDATION fieldbus, HART, field wireless (ISA 100.11a), conventional analogue d)

specifications.metric: ABB System 800xA S880 / Select I/O saf — safety I/O module types
specifications.basis: ABB System 800xA Safety Overview, copyright © 2025 ABB, read via r.jina.ai: 'Within the S880 I/O family, there are SIL3 compliant modules for safety critical applications including 4 - 20 mA analog inputs, 24 Vdc digital inputs and 24 Vdc digital outputs ... Analog inputs support HART routing'. (value: SIL3 compliant 4-20 mA analogue inputs, 24 Vdc digital inputs and 24 Vdc digital)
